passage.text: This notice is for everyone in the dormitory.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈnoʊtɪs ɪz fər ˈɛvriwʌn ɪn ðə ˈdɔːrmətɔːri.

passage.text: If you see a fire, press the fire alarm.
passage.reading: ɪf juː ˈsiː ə ˈfaɪər, ˈprɛs ðə ˈfaɪər əˌlɑːrm.

passage.text: When you hear the alarm, leave your room. Don't take your things with you.
passage.reading: wɛn juː ˈhɪr ði əˈlɑːrm, ˈliːv jʊr ˈruːm. ˈdoʊnt ˈteɪk jʊr ˈθɪŋz wɪð juː.

passage.text: Don't use the elevator. Use the stairs or the nearest fire exit.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈjuːz ði ˈɛləveɪtər. ˈjuːz ðə ˈstɛrz ɔːr ðə ˈnɪrɪst ˈfaɪər ˌɛɡzɪt.

passage.text: Gather in the parking lot in front of the building.
passage.reading: ˈɡæðər ɪn ðə ˈpɑːrkɪŋ ˌlɑːt ɪn ˈfrʌnt əv ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ.

passage.text: Don't go back into the building until a staff member says it's safe.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈɡoʊ ˈbæk ɪntə ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ənˈtɪl ə ˈstæf ˈmɛmbər ˈsɛz ɪts ˈseɪf.

passage.text: We have a fire drill every six months.
passage.reading: wiː ˈhæv ə ˈfaɪər ˌdrɪl ˈɛvri ˈsɪks ˈmʌnθs.

passage.text: The next fire drill is next Friday at ten in the morning.
passage.reading: ðə ˈnɛkst ˈfaɪər ˌdrɪl ɪz ˈnɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ ət ˈtɛn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: You'll hear the alarm, but don't worry!
passage.reading: juːl ˈhɪr ði əˈlɑːrm, bʌt ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri!
